preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
The number of goals scored by each team in a match is between 0 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The length of the name of each team does not exceed 10
preconditions.description: The length of the name of each team is at most 10 characters.

preconditions.expression: The name of each team contains only lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: The name of each team consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.description: The output contains two names for each test case, representing the top-ranked and second top-ranked teams.

postconditions.expression: all(name.islower() and name.isalpha() for name in output)
postconditions.description: Each team name in the output is in lowercase and consists of only English letters.
